Generation Experiments and Evaluation
|-- [M] Experiment design and reproducible inputs
|   |-- ExperimentService: save / approve / relaunch / judge
|   |   |-- Design groups cases, conditions, phases, samples and comparisons
|   |   |   `-- Each planned cell maps exactly once to a sample's stage output
|   |   |-- [C] save -> EvalRunService.prepareForReview -> retain prepared runs
|   |   |   |-- Validate project, AgentContext hashes and existing output references
|   |   |   `-- Expose generation review; preparation does not call the model
|   |   |-- [C] approve -> record approval -> launchPrepared for each unstarted run
|   |   |   |-- awaiting-approval -> starting -> started
|   |   |   |-- Persist started run IDs so approval can resume without relaunching them
|   |   |   `-- Approved plans, samples and inputs cannot be reassigned
|   |   `-- [C] relaunch -> validate edited stages -> fork prompt -> launchEdited
|   |       `-- Add a new sample attempt linked to its original sample and stage
|   |-- EvalPromptService: versioned authoring boundary
|   |   |-- save / fork / resolve / snapshot / archive
|   |   |-- Validate stage variables, section syntax and acyclic parent-version lineage
|   |   |-- Changed stage text or template base -> append a version
|   |   |-- [D] resolve(prompt ID, version, workflow) -> run prompt
|   |   |   `-- Stage text + template base + hash + lineage + copied cited references
|   |   `-- Workflow defaults become explicit saved text
|   |       `-- composePrompt substitutes variables; it adds no hidden instructions
|   `-- CompareSessionService: capture / create / createPinned
|       |-- [D] selected document + optional view + checkpoint -> CompareCanvasCopy
|       |   |-- Resolve generated snapshot or saved workspace history
|       |   |-- Reject changed views, missing checkpoints and mismatched revisions
|       |   `-- Deduplicate repeated source selections within one capture
|       |-- [O] copyCompareHistory owns an independent endpoint snapshot
|       |   |-- Retain selected checkpoint and required diagram revisions
|       |   `-- Drop undo/redo archive; later source edits do not change the copy
|       `-- createPinned builds diagram panes or whole-canvas comparisons
|           `-- Validate diagram slices, subtree references and focus targets
|-- [M] Run coordination: EvalRunService
|   |-- Public boundary: start / prepareForReview / launchPrepared / cancel
|   |   `-- Also exposes retained outputs, comparisons, deletion and promotion
|   |-- Private machinery: prepare -> execute -> chain -> step -> generateValidated
|   |-- Depends on injected boundaries
|   |   |-- AgentContextLibrary + EvalPromptService + CompareSessionService
|   |   |-- EvalRunStore + GeneratedCanvasSource + project catalog repository
|   |   `-- EvalRuntime.generate: schema, prompt, files, model, effort, abort signal
|   |-- [C] prepare -> construct queued run
|   |   |-- Validate workflow bindings and prompt/input contracts
|   |   |-- Pin prompt versions, references and selected canvas copies
|   |   |-- Record AgentContext identity and content hash
|   |   |   `-- Resolve evidence at execution; fail if its hash has changed
|   |   |-- Optional inputs: prior alternatives, canvas set, layout template
|   |   |   `-- Reuse matching pinned inputs when relaunching a run
|   |   `-- Ordinary cells = selected prompts x samples x workflow stages
|   |-- [C] launchPrepared -> save queued run -> start asynchronous execute
|   |   |-- Same request ID and hash -> existing run; conflicting content -> error
|   |   |-- One chain per prompt/sample; stages within a chain follow workflow order
|   |   |-- Default worker concurrency = 3; prepared session context uses 1 worker
|   |   `-- Finish by deriving run status from cells and persisting completion
|   `-- [C] generateValidated -> runtime.generate -> validate/materialize
|       |-- Valid output -> return result, accumulated usage and execution metadata
|       |-- Invalid output -> retry with previous-output.json + validation-error.json
|       |   `-- At most 3 generation attempts; original prompt remains the same
|       `-- Runtime failure or abort propagates; it is outside this validation retry
|-- [M] Workflow execution and output construction
|   |-- alternatives
|   |   |-- [D] pinned context + selected prompt + optional previous canvases
|   |   |   `-- Model output -> alternative materializer -> generated canvas
|   |   `-- Optional template contract -> template materializer fills its slots
|   |-- diagram-change-proposal
|   |   |-- [D] pinned context + proposal prompt -> proposal tree
|   |   `-- Preserve tree syntax errors for judging; render tree as a generated canvas
|   |-- roll-up
|   |   |-- [C] r2: child + parent context -> materializeRollUp -> save compressed canvas
|   |   |   `-- r2 fails -> mark g2 skipped
|   |   `-- [C] g2: saved r2 output + pinned parent -> materializeAttachment
|   |       |-- a: attach with edges; b: edit anchors; c: merge into parent diagrams
|   |       |-- Consume every r2 diagram exactly once through placement or merge
|   |       |-- Require an attachment edge and preserve parent positions
|   |       `-- Reanchor edited content edges; export an attached-parent history
|   |-- linked-canvases
|   |   |-- [D] pinned context + canvas inputs -> complete navigable canvas set
|   |   `-- materializeLinkedCanvases validates the entire graph in memory
|   |       |-- New canvas -> create diagrams and edges with namespaced IDs
|   |       |-- Existing canvas -> clone input, apply edits, reanchor edges
|   |       |-- Include every input canvas exactly once
|   |       |-- Validate jump text spans, targets and reachability from rootCanvas
|   |       `-- [O] Frozen EvalOutputResult owns all jumps and placement snapshots
|   |           `-- Replace old links so they cannot escape to live source canvases
|   |-- few-shot-refinement
|   |   |-- [C] execute delegates to executeFewShot
|   |   |-- [D] pinned context + first target diagram + one titled layout slot
|   |   |   `-- Five synthetic references -> 3 alternatives per round -> judge/refine
|   |   `-- Three rounds; retain one progress Judgement
|   |       `-- Final proposed references are untested recommendations
|   |-- diagram-history
|   |   `-- Separate history runner plans and executes against preceding pinned canvases
|   |       `-- Ordinary prepare rejects this workflow; run outputs can reference history artifacts
|   `-- Shared materialization boundary
|       |-- MappingDocumentController applies diagram, edge, view and jump operations
|       |-- [D] diagram IDs + nonblank content lines -> revision-aware edge anchors
|       `-- Edited edges follow matching text in new revisions or fail validation
|-- [O] State, evidence and runtime lifetimes
|   |-- Durable run record
|   |   |-- Retains request, prompt snapshots, input copies, context hashes and cell results
|   |   |-- Ordinary step -> save generated representation in project catalog
|   |   |   `-- Also retain endpoint history, placement snapshot and cell checkpoint
|   |   |-- Linked-canvas step -> retain frozen outputResults[cellKey] in the run
|   |   `-- captureOutputResult can pin a completed change-session proposal
|   |       `-- Check project/version; capture neither accepts it nor starts generation
|   |-- AgentContext groups generated outputs
|   |   |-- Canvas-only workflow creates an owning context from pinned inputs
|   |   `-- Reruns remain under the original run's context
|   |-- EvalRunService owns active execution state
|   |   |-- running: AbortController per run; live: mutable executing record
|   |   |-- Saves serialize per run so older snapshots cannot overwrite newer ones
|   |   |-- cancel -> abort; dispose -> abort all active runs and dispose runtime
|   |   |-- delete -> mark deleted, abort, drain saves, archive canvases, retain tombstone
|   |   |   `-- Deleted-run guard prevents later progress saves from restoring the run
|   |   `-- Restart -> unfinished ordinary cells fail; completed outputs remain
|   |-- AgentContextEvalRuntime owns one session per generate call
|   |   |-- No supplied AgentContext -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   |-- Supplied AgentContext -> resolve messages -> open independent session
|   |   |   |-- No tools, extensions, skills, context files, compaction or runtime retry
|   |   |   `-- Shared cache key uses model, effort, system prompt and context hash
|   |   |       `-- Independent session IDs; SSE avoids shared conversation state
|   |   |-- Subscribe to assistant output and usage; abort on signal or timeout
|   |   `-- finally -> clear timer, remove listener, unsubscribe, dispose session
|   `-- Compatibility boundary
|       |-- recordLegacy -> LegacyGenerationAdapter reconciles chat generations
|       `-- Migration preserves recorded chat provenance and skips active chat work
|-- [M] Assessment: JudgementService
|   |-- Public boundary: list / read / delete / saveDeterministic / saveProgress
|   |-- Private reconciliation imports comparison sessions and generation jobs
|   |   |-- [D] captured canvases + job/session result + owning run cells
|   |   |   `-- Typed Judgement with subjects, run IDs, evaluator and provenance
|   |   `-- Diagram comparison, canvas comparison or comparison report
|   |-- [C] ExperimentService.judge -> judgeDiagramChangeTrees -> saveDeterministic
|   |   |-- Select outputs by comparison phase, cases and conditions
|   |   |-- Require finished proposal cells with canvas/checkpoint evidence
|   |   `-- Store judgement and attach its ID to the experiment comparison
|   |-- [D] few-shot rounds -> saveProgress -> retained progress Judgement
|   `-- [O] Serialized writes and deletion tombstones protect retained assessments
|       `-- Restart marks unfinished eval-run judgements failed; completed rounds remain
`-- [C] Promotion: retained output -> published project work
    |-- promotionSource selects a finished cell's evidence
    |   |-- History artifact -> history result
    |   |-- Frozen outputResults entry -> independent copy
    |   `-- Generated canvas/checkpoint -> output result with placement information
    |-- [D] retained result + destination + expected revision -> prepared documents
    |   |-- Existing destination must be settled and at the expected revision
    |   `-- Unsaved workspace edits at that destination block promotion
    |-- promoteOutput -> prepareOutputPromotion -> catalog.publishOutputPromotion
    |   |-- Can create a project group or publish into a selected destination
    |   `-- Request ID + signature -> reusable receipt; mismatched signature -> conflict
    `-- backfillPlacementTracking links a historical whole-canvas promotion
        `-- Require matching original receipt and pinned output; serialize result updates
